issues.description: The template file src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java does not declare the expected public class Farm. Instead it declares a public class named 'AnimalFarm' (template: src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java, line 3) and contains a duplicated package declaration and repeated/malformed class content (template: src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java, lines 10–17). The problem statement (UML) and the solution expect a class named 'Farm' (problem_statement.md lines 16–22) with the API and structure shown in the UML and solution (e.g. public class Farm { private List<Animal> animals; public Farm() { ... } plus addAnimal, feedAllAnimals, singFarmSong, getters/setters) — see solution src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java (line 6). Because the template file name is Farm.java but the public class is named AnimalFarm and the file contains malformed duplicate package/class content, the starter code will not compile and students cannot implement or run the exercise as described.
